title: Order list with coloured status badges, tokens only
describe: an orders list with coloured status badges
prompt:
Build an orders page at /orders.

Requirements:
- A heading "Orders".
- A table of 4 orders, one per status: "Paid", "Pending", "Failed" and "Refunded". Each row has an order number, a customer name (make them up) and the status as a coloured badge. Paid is green, Pending is amber, Failed is red and Refunded is grey.
- Every colour must come from the theme's tokens (design-system classes or CSS variables defined in a stylesheet). Do not write a hex, rgb() or hsl() colour in any .ts or .tsx file.
- Keep it all on the client; there is no server.
